1_unseen_signer_macro_f1.metric: Macro-F1 across all 26 ISL letters (A-Z) on unseen signers
1_unseen_signer_macro_f1.blocking_reason: Physical recordings for Signer 2 and Signer 3 across all 26 classes do not yet exist in the repository.

2_letter_n_recall.measurement_method: Top-1 recall on held-out static crops and videos
2_letter_n_recall.blocking_reason: High confusion with Letter M (two-finger vs three-finger palm occlusion).

3_letter_l_accuracy.metric: Top-1 accuracy for Letter L across static and video benchmarks
3_letter_l_accuracy.measurement_method: Static Test A-L top-1 and continuous Standard L video frame accuracy
3_letter_l_accuracy.blocking_reason: Passed on static crops (94.6%) and in YOLO video (87.7%), but Late-Fusion on video is degraded by CNN visual bias toward Y.

4_end_to_end_cpu_latency.measurement_method: Full pipeline inference timing on 224x224 RGB video frames on CPU

5_worst_class_performance_and_stability.threshold: Worst-class recall >= 50.0% and Video flip rate < 15.0%
5_worst_class_performance_and_stability.metric: Minimum class recall and rolling smoothed prediction stability
5_worst_class_performance_and_stability.measurement_method: Per-class static recall evaluation and continuous video temporal tracking
5_worst_class_performance_and_stability.blocking_reason: Worst-class recall on N (25.0%) and X (38.0%) falls well below the 50.0% threshold.

6_api_and_frontend_contract_preservation.metric: Zero breaking changes to existing endpoints and response schemas
6_api_and_frontend_contract_preservation.measurement_method: Endpoint schema inspection and live server regression tests
6_api_and_frontend_contract_preservation.measured_value: All existing endpoints (/api/predict, /api/health, /api/detector/*) preserved with original keys

7_test_suite_success.measurement_method: unittest discover across all tests/ modules

8_safe_fallback_behavior.threshold: Zero server startup crashes and automatic fallback on failure
8_safe_fallback_behavior.metric: Try/except safety on missing artifacts or corrupted vectors
8_safe_fallback_behavior.measurement_method: Missing model artifact injection unit test
8_safe_fallback_behavior.measured_value: Graceful fallback to standard architecture verified

summary: Passed 4 of 8 acceptance gates (Latency, API Preservation, Test Suite, Safe Fallback). Failed 3 gates (Letter N Recall, Letter L Video Accuracy, Worst-Class Recall). 1 gate unverified due to missing physical multi-signer data. Production default MUST remain ISL_BACKEND_DETECTOR=yolo.
